answer: Re-attestations are stored in ripple and lotus lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the beacon graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1324 impostors cost 1417 times the honest price and take 5 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
